method_identity.name: LEARN_QUALITY
method_identity.candidate_pool: release raw road8_rank Top100 candidate records
method_identity.quality: mean over IoU 0.50:0.05:0.95 prefix marginal probabilities multiplied by frozen FIT class weight
method_identity.prediction_reuse: P1 stored post-temperature ten-threshold DEV probabilities; no second scaling and no across-seed prediction averaging

permutations.R0: frozen LC_ALLOC_R0_GROUP_V1 global order recovered from group_id then position_in_group

group_robustness.threshold_check: budget-matched ordered optional slots after mandatory ranks1..5; frozen tie semantics

external_baseline.paper: On Calibration of Object Detectors: Pitfalls, Evaluation and Baselines
external_baseline.diagnostic_role: CALIBRATION1000 only; no refit or model selection

official_defaults.pre_and_post_thresholds: per-class empirical LRP optimum on FIT
official_defaults.loss: mean BCE/NLL with matched IoU continuous target; unmatched target 0

external_baseline.predeclared_degenerate_fallback: identity mapping for fewer than two retained samples, nonfinite/NaN threshold, optimizer exception, or nonfinite fitted parameter; every fallback and reason recorded; never selected using DEV
external_baseline.fit_semantics_gate: BLOCKED_WITH_REASON if official matching/filtering/LRP/optimization semantics cannot be recovered from paper plus official source

solver.type: P1 exact float64 multiple-choice dynamic programming
solver.tie_break: caller image_id order; strict objective comparison; lexicographically smallest K vector

evaluation.gt_open_order: all allocations/selections committed and SHA-recorded before DEV GT evaluation
evaluation.quality: frozen class-weighted mean maximum matching over IoU 0.50:0.05:0.95
evaluation.coco: full DEV2000; original detector score; IoU 0.50:0.05:0.95; maxDets [1,10,100]

bootstrap.unit: complete allocation group for each fixed permutation and group size
bootstrap.other_configs: deterministic seed derived from config identity before results

runtime.boundary: host-resident raw policy-required candidate/native tensors through K and candidate record IDs
